widgets_values:
[VISUAL]
21-year-old Chinese woman running through a post-apocalyptic outdoor landscape at golden hour. She wears sleek silver-white ceramic tech-armor with glowing cyan circuit patterns, form-fitting cropped design showing toned midriff, low-rise tactical pants, fingerless gloves, knee-high combat boots with cyan-glow soles. Long black hair with platinum-silver highlights flowing dynamically in a high ponytail, fierce amber-gold eyes focused ahead. Background: open wasteland with scattered rusted structures, distant mountains under warm sunset sky, golden dust particles floating in air. Color palette: silver (#C0C0C0), cyan (#00FFFF), golden amber (#FFD700), deep navy (#0A0E27).

[CINEMATOGRAPHY]
Dynamic tracking shot, low angle following her movement from side-front. Camera smoothly tracks alongside at running pace, slight handheld motion for energy. Shallow depth of field: character sharp, background softly blurred with motion bokeh. Warm golden key light from sunset front-right, cool cyan fill from armor circuits, bright white rim light creating separation. Slight motion blur on background elements, sharp focus on face and armor details.

[CHARACTER MOTION]
Powerful running gait: arms pumping rhythmically, legs driving forward with athletic precision, torso leaning slightly forward for momentum. Hair and ponytail flowing backward with running speed, armor circuits pulsing gently in sync with movement rhythm. Facial expression: focused determination, slight breath visible in cool air, eyes scanning ahead. Subtle armor flex and fabric movement showing realistic physics.

[SOUNDS]
Rhythmic footfalls on gravel/dirt terrain, soft armor flex sounds, gentle circuit hum pulsing with movement, golden-hour wind through wasteland, distant ambient rustle of dry vegetation, subtle breathing rhythm matching running pace.

[NEGATIVE PROMPT]
No photorealism, no static pose, no slow motion, no indoor setting, no cyberpunk city, no heavy armor, no exaggerated anime style, no low quality, no blurry character, no inconsistent armor design.

inputs.text: A medium close-up shot features a Caucasian man with a closely shaven head and face, wearing a black baseball cap with "PNTR" in white letters on the front, and a dark grey t-shirt with "JUST DO IT" visible across his chest. A small black microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. He is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking intently downwards and to his right, his eyes focused off-camera. His facial expression is one of deep concentration, with his brow slightly furrowed. As he looks down, a quick sniff sound is heard, and then he speaks with a deep male voice and a slightly frustrated tone, saying, "I think it's so bad." The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
